gui.title: File Password Remover
gui.subtitle: Remove protection from a file you have the password for. Everything happens on this computer.
gui.choose.hint: Pick a protected PDF, Office document or archive.
gui.overwrite: Replace the file if it already exists
gui.restrictions: Also remove permission restrictions (needs the owner password)
gui.status.ok: Done. Verified unprotected copy written to {path}.
gui.status.original: The original file was not changed.
gui.error.title: Could not remove the protection
gui.about.body: File Password Remover {version}. No network access, no telemetry. Licensed under Apache-2.0.
